name: How long does sewer backup repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does sewer backup repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of sewer backup repair varies significantly depending on the complexity and cause of the problem. A simple clog cleared by hydro-jetting might take a few hours. More involved issues, such as root intrusion requiring extensive cleaning or pipe repair, could take half a day. Full sewer line replacement, especially if excavation is needed, can extend to several days. We provide an estimated timeline after our initial inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on the issue's complexity. Simple clogs take hours, while extensive repairs or pipe replacements can take days. An estimate is provided after inspection.
